title: Who Verifies the Tools? How Warped Formatters Mislead Agents and Their Verifiers
abstract: arXiv:2610.32110v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents and verifiers often rely on the text a tool prints, and that text can misrepresent what the tool actually did, even when the tool's computation is correct. We saw this happen in a production RAG research system used by the Pilsudski Institute in New York, where tool output formatters misled an agent into giving wrong or incomplete information to users. Each tool did its job correctly, but its output omitted search limits, result caps, or identifier namespaces. We also recreated an unlabeled estimate caught in code review before release. We studied whether these formatters misled agents and verifiers and how much the repaired wording helps. We fed tool results to agents using two formatter versions: one with the key omissions and one with all missing details clearly stated. That difference alone changed what the agents claimed and what the verifiers accepted. Unsupported agent claims dropped substantially for three of the four fail

translated_title: 谁来验证工具？失真的格式化输出如何误导智能体及其验证器
translated_abstract: 智能体和验证器通常依赖工具打印出的文本，而这些文本可能会歪曲工具实际执行的操作，即使工具本身的计算是正确的。我们在纽约Pilsudski研究所使用的生产级RAG研究系统中观察到了这一现象：工具的输出格式化器误导智能体向用户提供了错误或不完整的信息。每个工具都正确地完成了自己的任务，但其输出省略了搜索限制、结果数量上限或标识符命名空间等关键信息。我们还重现了一个在代码审查阶段、发布前被发现的未标注估计值。我们研究了这些格式化器是否会误导智能体和验证器，以及修复后的措辞能带来多大改善。我们向智能体提供了使用两种格式化器版本的工具结果：一个版本包含关键遗漏，另一个版本则清楚说明了所有缺失的细节。仅这一差异就改变了智能体的声称内容以及验证器所接受的内容。在四个失败案例中的三个里，智能体的无依据声称大幅下降（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 论文通过生产RAG系统的真实案例与对照实验发现，工具输出格式化器遗漏关键信息会误导智能体和验证器，而仅需在输出中补全这些缺失细节，就能显著减少智能体的无依据声称。
en_tdlr: Through a real production RAG system case study and controlled experiments, this paper shows that key omissions in tool output formatters mislead both agents and verifiers, and that simply making the missing details explicit substantially reduces unsupported agent claims.
